Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding health rules that pertain to school facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state board of health rules that impactschool districts; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: By June 30, 2011, the department of healthand the state board of health shall revise their rules pertaining toprimary and secondary school facilities to eliminate rules that areobsolete or not specifically funded or implemented.
